A1_nominal.description: Cooperative launcher, no injected delay, sequential runs.
A1_nominal.workload_critical_operation: TCP connect (wget) to closure-target-svc.workloads.svc.cluster.local after observing the launcher's ready-file

A2_readiness_stress.description: Same as A1, but the agent's first policy application for this specific pod is artificially delayed via the experiment.article2.io/inject-ready-delay-ms pod annotation (test-harness-only hook, zero effect without the annotation).

A3_concurrency.description: Multiple pods created concurrently (same trial mechanics as A1), to measure margin distributions -- especially min(Delta_PR) -- under submission load.
A3_concurrency.repetitions_note: Experiment protocol does not specify an exact repetition count for A3 (only A1=30, A2=20/delay have explicit targets). 5 repetitions/level was chosen as a documented, honest scope decision under real time constraints, not concealed as a larger number.

A4_noncooperative.description: Mandatory non-cooperative workload control: a real signed decision/policy exists (t_p is real), but the workload does NOT run the launcher, does NOT wait for EnforcementReady, and attempts its critical operation immediately at container start.

A5_no_policy_negative_control.description: No decision/policy is ever created. Determines externally (via RuntimeSecurityPolicy/RuntimePlacementEvidence existence, not workload self-report) whether the system produced ANY observation record for an unauthorized workload's attempted operation.

sample_size_discipline: n = number of independent pod/run lifecycles, never assertions x runs. Every run_trial() invocation is exactly one independent unit.
